channel.title: Robotics Directory - Cleaning Robots
channel.description: Browse 509 cleaning robots in the Robotics Directory. Specs, prices, images and comparison.

item.title: Cozio Home Robot
item.description: Home robot brand from Cozio Robotics Inc. The companion app advertises floor mapping, room and zone cleaning, schedules, no-go zones and live robot tracking; product-level specifications are not publicly disclosed.

item.title: ECOVACS Winbot W3 Omni
item.description: The ECOVACS WINBOT W3 Omni is a window cleaning robot with 3,300 +/- 100 Pa suction power while moving, support for 3 mm glass thickness, a floating cleaning cloth plate and WIN-SLAM 5.0 path planning. The multifunctional station provides Vortex Wash automatic wiping pad washing, hot air drying and a portable storage compartment. The package has a net weight of 12.22 kg and measures 418 x 398 x 510 mm. Current price is 699.99 USD. No robot dimensions, robot net weight, battery capacity, runtime in minutes, payload, travel speed, IP rating, degrees of freedom, cleaning width, hourly area rate or minimum aisle width is published; the catalog 700 USD price and medium size label are replaced or cleared.

item.title: Eufy Robot Vacuum Omni S2
item.description: The Eufy Robot Vacuum Omni S2 is a vacuum and mop robot featuring 30,000 Pa AeroTurbo 2.0 multi-cyclone suction, a HydroJet 2.0 roller mop with 15 N downward pressure at 240 RPM, and an Omni station with hot-water sterilization. Robot dimensions are 12.79 x 13.66 x 3.78 in (325 x 347 x 96 mm), and station dimensions are 15.08 x 18.39 x 26.38 in. Standard runtime is 150 min for vacuum and mop, and 179 min for vacuum only. It crosses thresholds up to 1.4 in single-layer (1.6 in double-layer) and features RGB camera, LED and 3D TOF obstacle avoidance. The station holds 3 L clean and 2 L dirty water tanks plus a 2.5 L dust bag. Current price is 1,599.99 USD. No robot net weight, battery capacity in mAh, travel speed or IP rating is published; the catalog 1600 USD price, medium size label and 180 min runtime are replaced or cleared.

item.title: Samsung Bespoke AI Steam (2026)
item.description: Steam-sterilizing vacuum-mop, doubled 10W suction, Easy Pass wheels clear 45mm, stereo 3D AI sensor

item.title: Roborock Saros 20
item.description: The Roborock Saros 20 is a vacuum and mop robot with an AdaptiLift Chassis 3.0 providing 3.46 in double-layer lift, 36,000 Pa HyperForce suction, the StarSight Autonomous System 2.0, FlexiArm edge and corner cleaning, and a RockDock with hot-water self-cleaning. SmartPlan 3.0 AI cleaning strategy, dynamic carpet cleaning up to 1.18 in pile, low-clearance navigation down to 3.13 in, cleaning beyond curtains, DirTect AI stain recognition, adaptive pressure mopping, the Hello Rocky voice assistant, pet-friendly recognition and video interaction, and Matter protocol compatibility complete the feature set. The page publishes no robot mass, dimensions, battery capacity, run time, charging time, IP rating, payload, travel speed, cleaning width, hourly area rate, tank capacity or minimum aisle width.

item.title: Roborock Qrevo Curv 2 Flow
item.description: The Roborock Qrevo Curv 2 Flow combines manufacturer-rated 20,000 Pa suction with a SpiraFlow roller mop spinning at up to 220 RPM. Eight hydration points feed fresh water across the 270 mm roller, while a scraper removes dirty water into a separate tank. The roller shield protects carpets and the roller lifts by up to 15 mm. An extending roller cleans near edges; the page describes 10 mm reach in prose and less than 10 mm in a graphic, so no exact edge-distance specification is generalized. DuoDivide and lifting arc side brushes support hair handling; Reactive AI uses structured light and an RGB camera to recognize over 200 object types, and PreciSense LiDAR maps cleaning routes. The dock washes the roller at up to 75 C, dries with 55 C air and supports up to 65 days between manual dust emptying as a manufacturer estimate. Published robot dimensions are 353 x 353 x 119 mm and dock dimensions 450 x 450 x 450 mm. Price, mass, battery capacity, runtime, tank capacity, charging time and IP rating are not published in the overview; the 270 mm figure is roller width, not a whole-machine cleaning-pass guarantee.

item.title: Dreame X60 Ultra
item.description: The Dreame X60 Ultra is a vacuum and mop robot with 35,000 Pa Vormax suction, a VersaLift DToF sensor that lowers the robot to 3.13 in (79.5 mm), dual omni-scrub mop pads with 40 C hot water, 230 RPM and 15 N downforce, and 100 C mop self-cleaning. The robot measures 350 x 350 x 79.5 mm with the sensor retracted and 350 x 350 x 103 mm with it lifted, and weighs 4.7 kg; the base station measures 390 x 423 x 499 mm and weighs 10.6 kg. A 6,400 mAh battery serves a 235 ml dust box, a 3.2 L dust bag, 4.2 L clean and 3.0 L used water tanks and up to 100 days of auto-empty, and charges from 9 to 80 percent in about 80 minutes. The robot crosses 8.8 cm double-layer and 4.5 cm single-layer obstacles and recognizes 280+ object types. The page lists 1,349.99 USD against a 1,499.99 USD regular price and publishes no full-charge runtime, dB rating, payload, travel speed, cleaning width, hourly area rate, IP rating or minimum aisle width.

item.title: MOVA P10 Pro Ultra Gen2
item.description: The MOVA P10 Pro Ultra Gen2 is a vacuum and mop robot advertised with 26,000 Pa suction, 12 N downward mop pressure and a mop rotating at 260 RPM. Published robot dimensions are 13.78 x 13.78 x 4.09 in and the mop can lift by 0.41 in. A 5,200 mAh battery supports the listed cleaning claims, and the dock is described with 212 F (100 C) mop washing, one-hour hot-air drying, a 3.2 L dust bag and 4.5 L clean with 4 L used-water capacity. These dock values are not robot tank capacity. The listed price is 499 USD and the embedded offer is in stock at the November 4, 2026 check. Robot mass, runtime, cleaning width, charging time, IP rating, payload and initial release year are not published. The 12 N mop pressure and 0.41 in mop lift are not payload or robot dimensions.

item.title: Yeedi M16 Infinity
item.description: 30,000Pa suction, OZMO Roller 3.0, ZeroTangle 4.0, flash charging

item.title: Yeedi S20 Infinity Ultra
item.description: 22,000Pa flagship with FocusJet stain pre-treatment and roller mop

item.title: Narwal Freo Z10 Turbo
item.description: The Narwal Freo Z10 Turbo is a robot vacuum and mop with 25,000 Pa suction, a DualFlow tangle-free system, a dual Reuleaux triangle mop with 12 N downward pressure and EdgeReach mop extension. It measures 13.98 x 13.78 x 4.24 in, weighs 4.5 kg (9.92 lb) and carries a 5,200 mAh battery. The adaptive dock measures 16.97 x 15.88 x 18.17 in, weighs 10.6 kg, washes the mops with water up to 161.6 F (72 C) and dries them with hot air. LDS navigation and detection for more than 100 objects guide the robot, which lifts its mops 12 mm on carpets and climbs thresholds up to 0.78 in (2 cm). The robot is covered by a 1-year warranty. The page publishes no run time in minutes, charging time, IP rating, payload, travel speed, cleaning width, hourly area rate, water tank capacity or minimum aisle width.

item.title: Proscenic Q20 Plus
item.description: 10,000Pa suction, 3D AI obstacle avoidance, 4L bagless auto-empty.

item.title: Xiaomi Mijia Robot Vacuum-Mop 4
item.description: 10000Pa LDS-navigation vac-mop with 5200mAh battery, budget-friendly

item.title: Dreame X60 Max Ultra Complete
item.description: Ultra-thin flagship robot vacuum with retractable legs and 35,000Pa suction.

item.title: ECOVACS Deebot X12 OmniCyclone
item.description: The ECOVACS DEEBOT X12 OmniCyclone is a bagless vacuum and mop robot with a claimed 22,000 Pa suction, FocusJet, OZMO roller mopping and a 12-in-1 Omni station. It measures 353 x 351 x 98 mm and weighs 5.5 kg; the station weighs 10.3 kg. It carries a 4,000 mAh Li-ion battery, charges in 2 h 25 min at 17.8 V and runs at 61.1 dB(A) in standard sweep and 64.4 dB(A) in sweep and mop. The reviewed page publishes a silent-sweep figure of 5,461 min over 5,236 m2 that is implausible for a 4,000 mAh battery, so no full-charge runtime is recorded. No payload, travel speed, water tank capacity or IP rating is published.

item.title: ECOVACS Deebot T90 Pro Omni
item.description: The ECOVACS DEEBOT T90 Pro Omni is a vacuum and mop robot with a claimed 30,000 Pa and 16 L/s suction, an OZMO roller mop and an OMNI station. It measures 353 x 351 x 95 mm and weighs 5.3 kg; the station weighs 7.9 kg and measures 338 x 281 x 500 mm without its base. It carries a 4,000 mAh SuperBoost Li-ion battery, charges in 2.5 h with PowerBoost charging and publishes 140 min silent sweep, 120 min standard sweep and 350 min standard sweep and mop runtime at 60 dB(A). The page states a deep-washing 10 min perpetual run, which is not a full-charge runtime. No price, payload, travel speed, water tank capacity or IP rating is published; the catalog 2,299 USD price and medium size label are not confirmed.

item.title: MOVA Mobius 60
item.description: The MOVA Mobius 60 is a vacuum and mop robot advertised with 30,000 Pa suction and a triple anti-tangle brush system. StepMaster 2.0 retractable legs are claimed to climb obstacles up to 3.14 in (8 cm). FlexScope lowers the navigation sensor for access under furniture and raises it for wider navigation. MopSwap is described with three interchangeable mop pads, and the mop extends up to 4 cm for edge cleaning. MOVA claims 240+ obstacle identification and a 100 C PTC hot-water washboard for mop cleaning. The dock also lists automatic refilling, dust emptying and mop drying, with two dust bags supplied and one pre-installed. The listed price is 849 USD against 1,299 USD compare-at, and the embedded offer is in stock at the November 4, 2026 check. Battery capacity, runtime, robot dimensions, mass, robot water-tank capacity, cleaning width, charging time, IP rating, payload and initial release year are not published in the reviewed product/specification sections. Obstacle height, mop extension and dock features are not robot dimensions, payload or cleaning width.

item.title: Roborock Saros Rover
item.description: Wheel-leg robot vacuum that climbs stairs while cleaning them.

item.title: Narwal Flow 2
item.description: AI flagship robot vacuum with VLM vision and 30,000Pa suction.

item.title: Shark PowerDetect UV Reveal (RV3020XE)
item.description: First robot vacuum-mop using UV light detection to reveal hidden pet messes.

item.title: Eufy Robot Vacuum Omni S2 Pro
item.description: The eufy Robot Vacuum Omni S2 Pro is a vacuum and mop robot with 40,000 Pa peak suction, AeroTurbo multi-cyclone filtration, a HydroJet 3.0 hot-water self-cleaning roller mop at 240 RPM and 16 N downward pressure, UV-C floor disinfection, electrolyzed-water disinfection and DuoSpiral detangling brushes. It measures 12.83 x 14.09 x 3.86 in, crosses two-tier thresholds up to 2.76 in and uses AI See 3.0 recognition of 360+ obstacle types. The Omni station measures 15.24 x 18.74 x 26.38 in and includes hot-water mop washing, hot-air drying and a built-in fragrance dispenser. The page publishes no robot mass, run time, battery capacity, charging time, IP rating, payload, travel speed, cleaning width, hourly area rate, station tank capacity or minimum aisle width.

item.title: LionsBot T1
item.description: AI-powered restroom cleaning robot equipped with dual-arm manipulators for scrubbing and litter collection.

item.title: DJI ROMO P2
item.description: Water-tank configuration of DJI ROMO 2, launched September 3, 2026. Vacuum-mop with adaptive swing arm and self-cleaning station; orders announced for September. Price is the European starting price.

item.title: DJI ROMO A2
item.description: Water-tank configuration of DJI ROMO 2, launched September 3, 2026. Vacuum-mop with adaptive swing arm and self-cleaning station; orders announced for September. Price is the European starting price.

item.title: iRobot Roomba Max 875 Combo
item.description: Vacuum-mop introduced September 2, 2026 with SealForce carpet sealing, supplier-rated 35,000 Pa suction and 20 L/s airflow. ThermaMist heated-mist pretreatment precedes a continuously cleaned roller rated 300 RPM and 18 N downward force; DriLift shields carpets. PerfectEdge extends the roller up to 45 mm. AutoWash uses 176°F wash water and 131°F drying air, with up to 90 days of debris storage. The 9.98 cm figure is robot height only. US launch MSRP is $1,199; current price and stock are unverified.

item.title: iRobot Roomba Plus 678 Combo
item.description: Vacuum-mop introduced September 2, 2026 with SealForce, 30,000 Pa rated suction and 18 L/s airflow. SprayForce AI pretreatment is separately rated 40,000 Pa spray pressure; it is not vacuum suction. The heated-water PowerSpin roller applies 15 N force, extends up to 45 mm and lifts 10 mm over carpet. AutoWash handles 176°F washing, 131°F drying and debris storage up to 90 days. US launch MSRP is $899; the 9.95 cm profile is height only.

item.title: Bear Robotics Servi Clean
item.description: Servi Clean sweeps, vacuums and dust mops hard floors and carpets, with a 10 L dustbin and 20 kPa suction. Dustbin volume is not cargo payload or a clean-water tank. Its operating times are four hours vacuuming and eight hours dust mopping; 1.5 h charging is separate. Cleaning width is 17.33 in and maximum stated efficiency is 7535 sq ft/h, not a measured site guarantee.

item.title: Tennant X2 ROVR SCRUB
item.description: Small circular BrainOS autonomous scrubber with pivot-in-place maneuvering, SelfPath AI / Teach & Repeat, dual-disk 406 mm path and velocity-controlled solution delivery. Optional X2 Dock RFSH charges, empties recovery, refills clean water and doses chemical. Manufacturer X-Series hourly area conversion is inconsistent.

item.title: SoftBank Robotics Whiz B
item.description: Whiz B is the separately named 2026 SoftBank Robotics Japan cleaning configuration. The large sweeper specifies 100 kg and 960×650×680 mm without side brushes/flag, with up to 2.75 h standard-mode operation. SoftBank attributes development, design and quality control; a visual resemblance or similar dimensions do not establish an OEM alias. Optional or unfinished SBX integration is not assumed universal.

item.title: SoftBank Robotics Whiz P
item.description: Whiz P is the separately named 2026 SoftBank Robotics Japan cleaning configuration. Its compact four-mode package lists 48 kg and 540×440×617 mm, with different scrub, vacuum, mop and sweep intervals. SoftBank attributes development, design and quality control; a visual resemblance or similar dimensions do not establish an OEM alias. Optional or unfinished SBX integration is not assumed universal.

item.title: SoftBank Robotics Whiz V
item.description: Whiz V is the separately named 2026 SoftBank Robotics Japan cleaning configuration. Its compact dry-cleaning package lists 47 kg and 540×440×595 mm, with five-hour vacuum, ten-hour sweep and eight-hour mop maxima. SoftBank attributes development, design and quality control; a visual resemblance or similar dimensions do not establish an OEM alias. Optional or unfinished SBX integration is not assumed universal.

item.title: iRobot Roomba Max 775 Combo
item.description: Vacuum-mop in iRobot’s July 7, 2026 North American introduction. The manufacturer describes ClearView Pro LiDAR, PrecisionVision AI, a continuously cleaned PowerSpin roller using 167°F water, a carpet-protective roller cover and anti-tangle brushes. Dock debris care is described for up to three months. The 4x suction claim compares Roomba 105; US MSRP $999.99 is dated launch pricing, not a current offer.

item.title: iRobot Roomba Max 715 Vacuum
item.description: Vacuum-only robot named in the July 7, 2026 North American launch. ClearView Pro LiDAR maps and names rooms; PrecisionVision AI supports obstacle avoidance. An anti-tangle brush and AutoEmpty dock with carbon debris bags support vacuum care. The 4x suction comparison is against Roomba 105 Combo. Up to three months of debris storage is not battery runtime; launch MSRP is $699.99.

item.title: iRobot Roomba Plus 575 Combo
item.description: Compact vacuum-mop in the July 7, 2026 North American launch, MSRP $799.99. It combines ClearView Pro dual-line LiDAR, PrecisionVision AI, SmartScrub and an AutoWash dock that dispenses solution and washes/dries pads. September’s Duo prototype release identifies Plus 575 as its demonstrated companion and gives 8.35 cm height, 29.8 cm width, up to 31 mm pad extension and 3.5 cm threshold crossing. These are Plus 575 details, not Duo main-unit specifications; 46% smaller refers to volume versus Plus 505.

item.title: iRobot Roomba Plus 515 Combo
item.description: Compact vacuum-mop introduced for North America July 7, 2026, launch MSRP $699.99. DualClean pads spin at 180 RPM with SmartScrub and carpet lift; AutoWash uses 167°F washing and 113°F drying. Dual-line LiDAR supports mapping. The source’s battery wording contradicts itself: 295 minutes is also described as about 10 hours, so no numeric runtime is promoted. Claimed 2,000 sqft per charge is coverage, not an area-per-hour rating. The 46% volume comparison and 3x suction compare Plus 505.

item.title: iRobot Roomba Plus 415 Combo
item.description: Compact vacuum-mop named in the July 7, 2026 North American launch, MSRP $599.99. It combines spinning DualClean mop pads, SmartScrub, ClearView dual-line LiDAR and dock debris emptying for up to three months with 113°F heated pad drying. Supplier 2.8x suction compares Roomba 105 Combo; 46% smaller compares volume versus Plus 505. Exact dimensions, battery duration, tank volume and current stock remain unverified.

item.title: iRobot Roomba Mini
item.description: Compact vacuum-or-mop robot introduced in Japan in mid-February 2026 and launched in the UK and Europe March 10, 2026 at €399/£379. It uses disposable mopping pads, ClearView LiDAR and rug avoidance while mopping. AutoEmpty stores debris for up to three months. Cleaning can start with the physical button without Wi-Fi; app and voice functions have separate connectivity requirements. Four colors are variants; exact dimensions and battery duration are not established by this release.

item.title: Narwal Freo 20
item.description: Robot vacuum with a FlowWash track mop that is cleaned in real time, and 31,000 Pa suction. Dual 1080p RGB cameras with an AI chip recognise more than 300 objects. The dock washes the mop with 100 C water, dries it with 60 C hot air and holds 120 days of dust.

item.title: Narwal Freo 20 Edge
item.description: Slim 9.5 cm robot vacuum with 31,000 Pa suction and a FlowWash TrackMop that extends dynamically toward edges. It navigates with hidden dToF LiDAR and structured-light 3D sensing. The dock washes the mop, dries it at 45 C and holds 120 days of dust. Launched in the US in September 2026.

item.title: Xiaomi Mijia Robot Vacuum-Mop 7 Max
item.description: China-market flagship robot vacuum-mop with 45,000 Pa suction and three robotic arms for edge cleaning. Its 3D area radar recognises more than 320 objects, and it crosses obstacles up to 6 cm high. The dock uses 50 C heated water and is offered with a water tank or a plumbed water connection.

item.title: Xiaomi Mijia Robot Vacuum-Mop 7C
item.description: China-market robot vacuum with 30,000 Pa suction and a powered roller mop that spins at 200 rpm while fed fresh water. An AI camera and line lasers recognise more than 220 obstacle types. The dock washes the roller, dries it with hot air and holds a 2.5 L dust bag.

item.title: Xiaomi Mijia Robot Vacuum-Mop 6
item.description: Slim 90 mm robot vacuum-mop with 28,000 Pa suction and a roller mop washed at 80 C. AI obstacle avoidance recognises 220 object types, and it climbs thresholds of up to 40 mm in two stages. Works with Mi Home and Xiao Ai, and a plumbed-water version is available.

item.title: Xiaomi Robot Vacuum 6 Max
item.description: Robot vacuum-mop with two bionic mechanical legs that cross single steps up to 6 cm. It has 35,000 Pa suction and pairs retractable dToF LiDAR with three cameras that recognise 327 obstacle, furniture and stain types. The dock self-empties, washes the roller mop above 85 C and dries it with air above 50 C.

item.title: Roborock Qrevo S Pro
item.description: 2026 robot vacuum with 18,500 Pa HyperForce suction, LiDAR mapping and Reactive Tech obstacle avoidance. Its dual spinning mops lift 10 mm on carpet. The dock self-empties, washes mops at 167 F, dries them with 113 F air and refills water automatically. Supports Matter.

item.title: Roborock Qrevo Edge 2
item.description: Low-profile (3.1 in) robot vacuum-mop with 25,000 Pa suction, retractable RetractSense LiDAR and Reactive AI vision obstacle detection. The dock self-empties, washes mops at 176 F and dries them with 131 F air. Runs up to 295 minutes in quiet mode on a 5200 mAh battery.

item.title: Kärcher RVF 7 Comfort
item.description: Kärcher's first robot vacuum with a roller mop. It has up to 13,000 Pa suction and AI camera obstacle and dirt detection, and its station empties the bin, refills and drains water and washes and dries the roller with hot water.

item.title: Roborock Saros Z70
item.description: The Roborock Saros Z70 is a vacuum and mop robot with a retractable robotic arm that picks up and moves items, 22,000 Pa HyperForce suction, dual all-rubber brushes and an integrated water tank. It measures 350 x 353 x 80 mm (13.78 x 13.89 x 3.14 in) and carries a 6,400 mAh lithium-ion battery that charges in 2.5 h. Roborock states about 135 min runtime with the robotic arm disabled and a mop-wash interval of 15 min, covering about 180 m2 per charge; with the arm enabled the stated coverage is about 150 m2. The robot and dock together weigh 38.14 lbs, but no separate robot net weight is published. It costs 999.99 USD. No payload, travel speed, IP rating or water tank capacity is published; the catalog 2599 USD price, ~4.5 kg mass, ~3 hours battery and 180 min runtime are replaced or cleared. The page prints 133.89 in for the second dimension figure, an evident typo for 13.89 in.

item.title: Dreame X50 Ultra
item.description: The Dreame X50 Ultra is a vacuum and mop robot with a 20,000 Pa suction system and retractable VersaLift sensor legs. The robot measures 350 x 350 x 89 mm with the sensor retracted and weighs 4.53 kg. Its 6,400 mAh battery provides up to 220 min of quiet-mode vacuuming and mopping, covering up to 205 m2 per charge; Dreame cites 30% faster charging but no absolute charging time. The ProLeap system crosses obstacles up to 6 cm high, and the AceClean DryBoard washboard sprays hot water through 20 nozzles. Dreame publishes 4.5 L clean and 4.0 L dirty water tanks, a 395 ml dust box and a 9.09 kg base station. The reviewed page publishes no dB noise rating, payload, travel speed or IP rating.

item.title: ECOVACS Deebot X8 Pro Omni
item.description: The ECOVACS DEEBOT X8 PRO OMNI is a vacuum and mop robot with 18,000 Pa suction and OZMO roller mopping. The roller mop scrubs at 200 rpm, and TruEdge 2.0 extends it along edges and corners. A 6,400 mAh battery provides up to 291 min in silent sweep mode and charges in 4 h 37 min. The OMNI station washes the mop at 40-75 C, dries it with 63 C hot air and holds a 3 L dust bag. ECOVACS publishes 353 x 351.5 x 98 mm robot dimensions, 5.3 +/- 0.1 kg DEEBOT net weight, 4 L clean and 4 L dirty water tanks and 65 dB sweep noise. The reviewed page publishes no payload, travel speed or IP rating.

item.title: MOVA V50 Ultra Complete
item.description: The MOVA V50 Ultra Complete is a vacuum and mop robot advertised with 24,000 Pa suction, a dual rotary mop spinning at 260 RPM and a JetSpray washboard with 20 water nozzles. StepMaster retractable legs are claimed to cross obstacles up to 6 cm, including a two-layer threshold and a 4.2 cm vertical step; these are obstacle-crossing claims, not robot dimensions. The dock is described with automatic hot-water tank refill, dual cleaning-solution compartments of 400 ml general solution and 200 ml pet odor eliminator, dust-box and dust-bag drying, and 60 C hot-air mop drying for one hour. A 3.2 L dust bag is claimed to support up to 100 days between manual emptying. The page states a 6,400 mAh battery but publishes no runtime, robot dimensions, mass, robot water-tank capacity, cleaning width, charging time, IP rating, payload or initial release year. The listed price is 799 USD and both embedded offers are marked out of stock at the November 4, 2026 check. Battery capacity is not converted into runtime; obstacle height and dock capacities are not robot dimensions, payload or cleaning width.
